title: Delta Characters and Filtered Isocrystals
summary: Given an abelian scheme $A$ over a $p$-adic ring $R$, Borger and Saha constructed a filtered module $\{\mathbf{H}_δ(A) \supset \mathbf{X}_{\mathrm{prim}}(A)\supset \{0\}\}$ with a semilinear operator $\mathfrak{f}^*$ on $\mathbf{H}_δ(A)$ using the theory of arithmetic jet spaces. The above object admits a canonical map $Φ$ to the Hodge sequence $\{\mathbf{H}^1_{\mathrm{dR}}(A) \supset H^0(A,Ω_A)\supset \{0\}\}$ of $A$ in the category of filtered modules. As a result, by restricting $Φ$, we obtain a natural $R$-linear map $Υ: \mathbf{X}_{\mathrm{prim}}(A) \rightarrow H^0(A,Ω_A)$. In this…
